To compare our signaling / non-signaling wireless communication tester solution with a competitor, use R&S formal specifications, features documents, conformance reports, configuration / ordering evidence, and competitor official data rather than battle-card sales language.[5]
For CMX500 claims, cite the formal CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher, because the CMX500 page identifies those as the sources for specifications and software features.[23]
Treat CMX500 Features and Functions as non-binding unless tolerance limits are given, because the source says “Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding.”[23]
For CMX500 signaling capability, use the documented LTE, NR FR1 / FR2, WLAN, RedCap, eRedCap, NTN, NB-NTN, fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput, PER, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA, GUI, XLAPI, and SCPI feature evidence.[20]
For CMX500 option-level claims, cite the listed NR / LTE / WLAN / RedCap / eRedCap / NTN option codes and order-number evidence instead of inferring availability.[22][24][49][52][54]
For CMX500 hardware claims, cite the ordering and hardware-unit evidence such as CMX500 base unit, CMX-PB70H, CMX-B200A, CMX-B300C, CMX-B500A, and CMX-B600B.[25]
For FR2 / mmWave claims, cite documented CMX500 hardware evidence such as CMXHEAD30 up to 43.5 GHz and CMXHEAD50 up to 50.2 GHz, where applicable.[50]
Do not use “only,” “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability,” or “lower TCO” as verified technical claims unless backed by formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, or configuration tools.[5]
For Keysight comparisons, obtain Keysight official datasheets, versioned configuration documents, WLAN option documents, E7515R official specifications / order data, and roadmap evidence, because the battle-card passages explicitly say those items are missing.[4][7]
For Anritsu comparisons in customer documents, obtain Anritsu official data and third-party evidence, because the Anritsu battle-card claims are mainly R&S internal sales positioning.[15]
For Anritsu Virtual Signalling Tester claims, cite the Anritsu brochure evidence only for what it states: MX844030PC is Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software supporting MAC-IF, PHY-IF Digital-IQ, and RF-IF for RedCap, with common RTD GUI workflow portability.[14]
For conformance or operator-acceptance claims, obtain test-package option codes, accreditation documents, validation reports, or test-case lists, because the existing battle-card table says these are not provided for several such claims.[18]
For validated NTN claims, obtain the Samsung validation report or test-case list, because the existing source notes that the battle card does not list those documents.[18]
For non-signaling / production-path claims, obtain the formal specifications or features documents for the relevant production / non-signaling platforms, because the CMX500 Callbox material is sales / training content and cannot replace CMX500 formal specifications or features documents.[61]
For TCO, calibration-count, license-count, or throughput-advantage claims, provide the actual calculation or test evidence, because the cited battle-card source says the lower-TCO message lacks a TCO formula.[13]
For any competitor “fragmented,” “multi-tool,” “external dependency,” or “selected model only” claim, cite competitor official documentation or clearly label it as R&S sales positioning, because the Keysight and Anritsu pages identify those statements as battle-card positioning with source limitations.[7][15]

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？
7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？
8. Operators 或 certification bodies 是否要求 specific timeline 上的 validated NR-NTN conformance？
9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 Keysight 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 提供 one-platform integration，涵蓋 cellular FR1 / FR2 / FR3 path、Wi-Fi、fading、IP/application testing、NTN、RedCap、RF analysis 與 signaling；相對地，Keysight 被描述為依賴 multiple UXM SKUs、add-on software 與 external tools。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + WLAN + Fading + IP + NTN + RedCap**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system；對比 Keysight 需要 E7515P / E7515B / E7515E、E7515W、E7515R、RaySim / Channel Studio 與 additional tools。
- **FR2 / NTN Conformance Leadership**：主張 CMX500 有 50 GHz mmWave (RRH evo)、FR2 maturity、first validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance with Samsung、RedCap via OBT-Lite。
- **WLAN in Every Configuration**：主張 CMX500 可在每個 configuration 中整合 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling；對比 Keysight Wi-Fi 只在 E7515W 或 E7515P。
- **FR3 / 6G on One Platform**：主張 CMX500 可透過 [[RFU18]] 與 6G-relevant testing 演進，包含 AI-CSI feedback、satellite Doppler、NTN mobility、FR3 channel models；對比 Keysight multi-component approach。
- **Unified Automation**：將 CMsquares、CMsequencer、CONTEST、AI Script Assistant 定位為 one unified environment；對比 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、WLAN-specific tools、Nemo、UXM-specific application features。
- **Simplify the Message**：以 fewer boxes、fewer SKUs、more capability、lower TCO 作為 sales headline。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Keysight positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform architecture | one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap | multiple UXM SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]] / [[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] + external tools | battle card 未提供 Keysight 官方資料；R&S one-platform 說法需回查 CMX500 options |
| FR1 / FR2 | quick table 寫 FR1 up to 18 GHz、FR2 up to 50 GHz (RRH evo) | E7515P up to 15 GHz；FR2 split 24.25–29.5 GHz and 37–43.5 GHz | R&S FR1 up to 18 GHz 與正式規格口徑衝突，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| RFU18 / FR3 | [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz；max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz；single-platform FR3 path | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | RFU18 未有正式規格文件；Keysight roadmap 需官方證據 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling possible to integrate in every CMX500 configuration | Wi-Fi only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | CMX500 WLAN options 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]；Keysight 需官方資料 |
| Fading / Doppler / satellite | integrated in one box | [[RaySim]] / [[Channel Studio]] / [[ProbSim]] external for advanced fading and digital twin | source 未列 option code 或正式 workflow |
| IP / application testing | Integrated FTP / HTTP / DNS、IMS、VoNR、VoWiFi | often additional tools and PC | CMX500 application options 需回查正式 features 文件 |
| Software / automation | [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] as one ecosystem | [[Atlas]] + [[Channel Studio]] + [[RaySim]] + WLAN tools + [[Nemo]] + UXM features | AI Script Assistant / CONTEST 在本來源中未提供文件版次；Keysight toolchain 需官方資料 |

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Battle card 中的 R&S positioning
來源的 positioning statement 主張：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] delivers the industry’s only fully integrated platform for FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、RF analysis、NTN、RedCap and end-to-end signalling in one instrument。
- 來源說 [[Keysight]] spreads equivalent capabilities across multiple UXM models、add-on software and external tools。
- 來源說 R&S ensures long-term scalability、measurement accuracy and path from R&D to certification without hardware fragmentation。

使用限制：以上是 sales language；其中 only、industry’s only、fully integrated、long-term scalability、lower TCO 等敘述不能當作可驗證規格，需回查正式 datasheet、features document、conformance report 或配置工具。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。
- 來源主張 [[R&S CMX500]] 的差異化包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP + application testing、unified software ecosystem（[[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、AI Script Assistant）、measurement leadership、FR3 / 6G path、cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform，以及 NTN / RedCap / operator certification leadership。
- 來源對 [[Keysight]] 的弱點敘述包含 hardware fragmentation、multi-tool workflow、advanced testing external dependencies、limited legacy、Wi-Fi only on selected models、FR3 / 6G roadmap relies on add-ons。
- 來源的 quick comparison table 將 R&S / CMX500 描述為 one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap；將 Keysight 描述為 multiple UXM SKUs + external tools。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 對 Keysight 的主要主張
| 主題 | 來源對 Keysight 的說法 | 限制 |
|---|---|---|
| Portfolio | UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms E7515B/W/P/E/R、ProbSim、Nemo、RaySim、Atlas、C-V2X、cybersecurity tools | 未提供 Keysight 官方 datasheet 或版本 |
| Architecture | Multi-Box UXM approach；不同 UXM 有不同 NR bandwidth、RF ports、Rel-17 support、WLAN capability、IP throughput、FR2 readiness | 未列各 SKU 的完整規格條件 |
| Software model | Atlas + Channel Studio + RaySim + Nemo + WLAN tools + UXM-specific features；no unified automation environment | 這是 R&S battle card 觀點，需 Keysight 官方資料驗證 |
| Support model | tiered KeysightCare model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support；optional warranty / calibration assurance plan | 未提供 KeysightCare 文件版次或服務條款 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi signaling only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | 未提供 Keysight WLAN option / configuration 文件 |
| RedCap | E7515R is dedicated RedCap / IoT model | 未提供 E7515R 官方規格或 order data |
| FR3 / 6G | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | future hardware / software 未標示日期、型號或 release status |

- [[Keysight UXM]] — 來源中的 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms 總稱。
- [[Keysight E7515P]] — 來源稱 high-end wideband / 5G platform with Wi-Fi as additional capability；quick table 稱 E7515P up to 15 GHz。
- [[Keysight E7515W]] — 來源稱 Wi-Fi 7 / connectivity platform。

- [[Keysight E7515E]] — 來源稱 value / mid-tier 5G UXM。

- [[Channel Studio]] — channel modeling / fading 相關 external tool。
- [[Nemo]] — field test tools；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[Atlas]] — AI-powered device test / test management；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[KeysightCare]] — 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered KeysightCare：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，以及 optional warranty / calibration assurance plan。

To compare our signaling / non-signaling wireless communication tester solution with a competitor, use R&S formal specifications, features documents, conformance reports, configuration / ordering evidence, and competitor official data rather than battle-card sales language.[5]
For CMX500 claims, cite the formal CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher, because the CMX500 page identifies those as the sources for specifications and software features.[23]
Treat CMX500 Features and Functions as non-binding unless tolerance limits are given, because the source says “Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding.”[23]
For CMX500 signaling capability, use the documented LTE, NR FR1 / FR2, WLAN, RedCap, eRedCap, NTN, NB-NTN, fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput, PER, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA, GUI, XLAPI, and SCPI feature evidence.[20]
For CMX500 option-level claims, cite the listed NR / LTE / WLAN / RedCap / eRedCap / NTN option codes and order-number evidence instead of inferring availability.[22][24][49][52][54]
For CMX500 hardware claims, cite the ordering and hardware-unit evidence such as CMX500 base unit, CMX-PB70H, CMX-B200A, CMX-B300C, CMX-B500A, and CMX-B600B.[25]
For FR2 / mmWave claims, cite documented CMX500 hardware evidence such as CMXHEAD30 up to 43.5 GHz and CMXHEAD50 up to 50.2 GHz, where applicable.[50]
Do not use “only,” “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability,” or “lower TCO” as verified technical claims unless backed by formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, or configuration tools.[5]
For Keysight comparisons, obtain Keysight official datasheets, versioned configuration documents, WLAN option documents, E7515R official specifications / order data, and roadmap evidence, because the battle-card passages explicitly say those items are missing.[4][7]
For Anritsu comparisons in customer documents, obtain Anritsu official data and third-party evidence, because the Anritsu battle-card claims are mainly R&S internal sales positioning.[15]
For Anritsu Virtual Signalling Tester claims, cite the Anritsu brochure evidence only for what it states: MX844030PC is Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software supporting MAC-IF, PHY-IF Digital-IQ, and RF-IF for RedCap, with common RTD GUI workflow portability.[14]
For conformance or operator-acceptance claims, obtain test-package option codes, accreditation documents, validation reports, or test-case lists, because the existing battle-card table says these are not provided for several such claims.[18]
For validated NTN claims, obtain the Samsung validation report or test-case list, because the existing source notes that the battle card does not list those documents.[18]
For non-signaling / production-path claims, obtain the formal specifications or features documents for the relevant production / non-signaling platforms, because the CMX500 Callbox material is sales / training content and cannot replace CMX500 formal specifications or features documents.[61]
For TCO, calibration-count, license-count, or throughput-advantage claims, provide the actual calculation or test evidence, because the cited battle-card source says the lower-TCO message lacks a TCO formula.[13]
For any competitor “fragmented,” “multi-tool,” “external dependency,” or “selected model only” claim, cite competitor official documentation or clearly label it as R&S sales positioning, because the Keysight and Anritsu pages identify those statements as battle-card positioning with source limitations.[7][15]
